summary: Brass section: funk and disco hits, soul, big band
label: brass section
body: Short stabs on accents, unison riffs. 80s synth brass: GeneralUser GS/Synth Brass 1.

Register: MIDI 48-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Brass Section, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Brass Section") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
